metadata.description:
In a small village in Palghar district of Maharashtra, there was film stars from South India all over in a weekly market. Presently the posters of Pushpa and RRR films are dominating here. We also noticed that there are prints of the stars of these films on the clothes too. Apart from this, there is a lot in this market to see.
